text: {"name":"log_ps_disable_message","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Logs a PS_DISABLE confirmation value and, when logging is enabled and the context flush counter reaches zero, clears related context dirty flags and sends the log event to the host.","subsystem":"libmisc","var_renames":{"a1":"log_category","a2":"ps_state_value","result":"log_ctx","i":"context_node","v6":"flush_counter"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"ready/enable byte cleared before sending the host event"},{"offset":2,"meaning":"16-bit value passed to hci_evt_alloc_send, likely log/event length or parameter"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"byte counter or threshold controlling periodic flush/trigger"},{"offset":0,"meaning":"intrusive list next pointer in context nodes"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"dword context state bits; bits 1-3 are cleared when related byte flags permit"},{"offset":106,"meaning":"context byte flag checked before clearing state bits"},{"offset":108,"meaning":"context byte flag enabling clearing of dword state bits"}]}
